common.tagline: The free 360 and photo booth that runs in your browser.
common.offline: You're offline. Everything you capture is saved on this device and uploads when the connection returns.

home.eyebrow: Free forever · No watermark · Any device
home.title: Turn any screen into a 360 and photo booth.
home.lede: Capture spins and photo strips in the browser, render on the device, and hand every guest their file by QR in under a minute. Unlimited devices on one account.
home.enterCode: Have a code from a booth?

points.freeBody: No paywall, no watermark and no per-device fee. Ever.
points.offlineBody: Keep capturing when the venue Wi-Fi drops. Nothing recorded is ever lost.
points.anyBody: Laptop, tablet or phone in a modern browser. Install it like an app.

design.title: Design system
design.subtitle: Immersia Booth's light, editorial language: paper, ink and one accent.
design.qrAlt: QR code that opens this session's download page

meta.description: Immersia 360 is a free, browser-based 360 video and photo booth. No paywall, no watermark, unlimited devices.

signIn.title: Sign in to Immersia 360
signIn.subtitle: We'll email you a sign-in link. No password to remember.
signIn.guestNote: Guests never need an account. They get their photos and videos by scanning a QR code.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.

magicLink.subject: Your Immersia 360 sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Immersia 360
magicLink.body: Click the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in 10 minutes.
magicLink.footer: If you didn't ask for this email, you can ignore it.

invitation.subject: Join {organization} on Immersia 360
invitation.heading: You're invited to {organization}
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to help run booths as {role}.

guestLink.subject: Your video from {event}
guestLink.heading: Your moment from {event}
guestLink.body: Watch, download and share it from your page. The link works until {date}.
guestLink.footer: You got this because you asked for it at the booth. We don’t keep your address.

launcher.title: What are we running?
launcher.subtitle: Start a new event in either booth mode. Everything is free, on every device.

video360.title: 360 Booth
video360.body: Spin videos with slow motion, music, overlays and effects, rendered on this device.

photo.title: Photo Booth
photo.body: Photo strips and collages, GIFs and boomerangs, with printing at exact size.

launcher.emptyBody: Pick a booth mode above to create your first event.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Every event on this account, across all your devices.
events.duplicateBody: The copy keeps every setting, overlay and asset. Guest files are not copied.
events.emptyBody: Create an event to set up your booth.
events.noMatchBody: Try a different search or clear the filters.

errors.duplicate: Couldn't duplicate the event. Please try again.
errors.archive: Couldn't update the event. Please try again.

newEvent.title: New event
newEvent.subtitle: You can change everything later.
newEvent.name: Event name
newEvent.modeHelp: One event runs one booth mode. Run a second event for the other booth.
newEvent.expiryHelp: Hosted downloads are deleted after this. Connect your own cloud to keep them for good.

errors.generic: Couldn't create the event. Please try again.

dashboard.renderQueueHint: Takes waiting to render on booth devices
dashboard.removedHint: Files deleted after the event’s retention
dashboard.extendHelp: Gives every live guest link more time. Files that have already expired can’t be brought back.
dashboard.extended: {count, plural, =0 {No live links to extend} one {# link extended by {days} days} other {# links extended by {days} days}}
dashboard.extendFailed: Couldn’t extend the links. Try again.

save.error: Couldn't save. Your last change will retry.

issues.slow_motion_outside_spin: The slow-motion segment must end within the spin.
issues.slow_motion_end_before_start: The slow-motion segment must end after it starts.
issues.half_second_grid: Use steps of half a second.
issues.trim_end_before_start: The music must end after it starts.
issues.generic: Some settings are out of range.

basics.title: Basics
basics.name: Name
basics.modeHelp: Switching mode keeps the other mode's settings for later.
basics.expiryHelp: Hosted downloads are deleted after this. You can extend it before it runs out.
basics.prefixHelp: Add 0001_, 0002_ … in front of every file name.

video.title: 360 video
video.subtitle: What each spin records and how it's rendered.
video.resolutionHelp: 4K only where the camera supports it.
video.spinHelp: Recording stops on its own after this.
video.slowMoHelp: Slow down one part of the spin; the rest plays at normal speed.
video.slowMoRangeHelp: Seconds from the start of the spin.
video.reverseHelp: Play the segment back and forth, or add it reversed at the end.

qualityHelp.balanced: About 8–12 MB per 15 s clip at 1080p.

video.microphoneHelp: Off by default: the soundtrack comes from the event's music.

photo.title: Photo booth
photo.subtitle: Shots per session, outputs and printing.
photo.shortVideoHelp: A short clip around each photo, like a Live Photo.
photo.autoPrintHelp: Silent printing needs Chrome in kiosk-printing mode.
photo.doubleStripHelp: Print two 2×6 strips side by side, then cut.

triggers.title: Starting a capture
triggers.subtitle: How guests or the operator start recording.
triggers.keyboardHelp: Space, Enter or a remote's page buttons.
triggers.motionHelp: Start when the platform starts turning.
triggers.sensitivityHelp: How much of the picture must move sideways. Lower starts sooner.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.subtitle: How guests get their files.
sharing.smallerHelp: A lighter copy that sends quickly over WhatsApp.
sharing.stripQrHelp: A small code in the corner of each print links to the digital copy.
sharing.endFrame: QR code at the end of videos
sharing.endFrameHelp: A 2-second end card, so a forwarded video still leads back to the download.
sharing.guestFormHelp: Name and email with a consent checkbox before download.
sharing.consentHelp: What guests agree to, in your words.
sharing.contactHelp: Shown on guest pages once this event’s files have expired, so guests can reach you. An email address or phone number.

kiosk.title: Kiosk
kiosk.subtitle: Lock the booth screen for events that run unattended.
kiosk.pinHelp: 4 to 8 digits. With a PIN set, the booth runs full screen and guests can’t leave it; the booth checks the PIN even offline.
kiosk.statusOff: No PIN: the booth screen isn’t locked
kiosk.removed: PIN removed: the booth is no longer locked
kiosk.failed: Couldn’t save the PIN. Try again.

audioEditor.empty: Add a song to edit it here.
audioEditor.decodeError: This audio file couldn’t be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
audioEditor.songHelp: Drag the handles to choose the part of the song that plays.
audioEditor.inVideoHelp: Where the music sits on the video’s timeline, and how loud it is.
audioEditor.stripEmpty: The music doesn’t play within the video. Start it earlier or keep a longer part of the song.
audioEditor.clipped: The video ends before the song does, so the fade-out lands at the end of the video.
audioEditor.offsetHelp: Seconds into the video when the music begins.
audioEditor.fadeInHelp: How long the music takes to rise from silence.
audioEditor.fadeOutHelp: How long it takes to sink back to silence at the end.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Every laptop, tablet and phone that runs a booth for this account. There's no limit.
devices.thisBrowser: Use this browser as a booth
devices.thisBrowserBody: Register it to run booths here. It keeps uploading for the whole event, and you can revoke it at any time.
devices.registerBody: Give it a name you'll recognise at the venue.
devices.name: Name
devices.revokeBody: This device stops uploading and can't run booths for this account until it's registered again. Files already uploaded stay.
devices.emptyBody: Register this browser, or sign in on another device and register it there.

errors.register: Couldn't register this device. Please try again.
errors.storage: Registered, but this browser blocks storage, so it won't remember it. Allow site data and register again.

booth.startHint: Check the camera, then hand over to your guests.

warnings.storage: This device had trouble saving the last take. Everything up to the problem was kept. Check free storage.

errors.title: The camera isn't available
errors.permission: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera for this site in the browser settings, then try again.
errors.not_found: No camera was found. Plug one in or choose another in settings.
errors.in_use: Another app is using the camera. Close it, then try again.
errors.overconstrained: This camera can't deliver the event's resolution or frame rate. Choose another camera or lower them in event setup.
errors.insecure: The camera only works over a secure (https) connection.
errors.recording_unsupported: This browser can't record video. Use Chrome, Edge or Safari.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong starting the camera.

settings.title: Booth settings
settings.mirrorHelp: Only on this screen. Recordings are never mirrored.
settings.noTorch: This camera has no controllable light.
settings.motionHelp: Recording starts when the platform starts turning.
settings.importHelp: Add clips from files, including 120 or 240 fps slow-motion videos.

register.title: Register this device
register.body: Booths run on registered devices so every take and upload belongs to your account. You can revoke it at any time.
register.name: Device name
register.error: Couldn't register this device. Please try again.
register.forbidden: Your role can't register devices. Ask the account owner.
register.storage: Registered, but this browser blocks storage, so it won't remember it.

renderErrors.unsupported_encoder: This browser can't encode the video
